summary: A single-user home book shelf app: add books (title, author, kind), lend them out to named borrowers, mark them returned, edit or delete entries, see all books in one list, filter to only the ones currently out, and see how many are lent out. Data persists in the browser via localStorage.
implemented_features: Add a book with title, author, and kind (novel/cookbook/reference/other)
List every book in one sorted list with empty state
Delete a book added by mistake
Lend a book out by noting a borrower name (repeated lending updates the name)
Mark a lent book as returned (clears the borrower)
Filter the list to only the books currently out with someone
See a live count of how many books are lent out right now
Persist all books across a page refresh via localStorage
Validate empty/blank input for titles, authors, and borrower names
Gracefully drop malformed persisted data instead of crashing
assumptions: The idea lists 'novel, cookbook, reference thing' as example kinds; I modeled categories as a fixed enum of novel/cookbook/reference/other so the data stays consistent and the filter remains meaningful, with 'other' as an escape hatch for anything else.
Single-user, own-computer use means no login, no sharing, and no backend are needed; data is stored locally in the browser via localStorage.
'Roughly what kind of book' implies a single category per book rather than free-form tags, so each book has one category selected from a short list.
Lending is the only mutable status; a book is either on the shelf or out with one named borrower, so return simply clears that name rather than tracking a history of loans.
The count of books lent out is the single derived value the idea asks for; no other derived metrics were implied.

tests_run.journey: Add a book with title, author, and kind, see it listed, and confirm the lent-out count shows zero
Prevent adding a book without a title and show a validation error
Lend a book to a named borrower, see it marked as out, and see the lent-out count update
Mark a lent book as returned and confirm the borrower is cleared
Filter the shelf to show only the books currently out with someone
Edit an existing book's title and see the updated details
Delete a book added by mistake and confirm it leaves the list
Books persist across a component reload that re-reads localStorage
Domain logic trims inputs, lends and returns books, counts lent-out, and rejects blank fields
Persistence round-trips books and drops malformed stored entries without crashing
